title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from the front and above. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square, the one nearest you on the left. An orange disc marks the goal on the top-right square, the one farthest from you on the right. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow pointing along a move that brings the token one step closer. Readouts show the moves made and the steps left to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes one row or one column. The goal is 2 columns right and 2 rows up, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves the token away from you on the board, Down toward you. A move that would leave the board does nothing and is not counted.
The start and goal never change, and there are no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
